title: Two critical vulnerabilities in php (presumably since php 5) release today 14:00 UTC
description: Two critical vulnerabilities in PHP, presumably affecting versions since PHP 5, were announced with a planned security release on October 21, 2026, at 14:00 UTC. Both vulnerabilities have a high severity rating of CVSSv4 9.2. The PHP security team has issued advance notice to encourage users to prepare for the update. No detailed technical information or affected versions have been disclosed yet. There is no current evidence of active exploitation. Users should monitor official PHP channels for the release and update promptly once available.
